scripts.build:core: cd apps/backend && go build -o bin/decm-backend core-api/cmd/main.go
scripts.docs:core: cd apps/backend && swag init -g core-api/cmd/main.go -o core-api/docs
scripts.gen-api:core: pnpm run docs:core && cd packages/api && pnpm install && pnpm generate:core && pnpm run build
scripts.db:setup: pnpm run db:start && pnpm run db:wait && pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.db:reset: pnpm run db:migrate:down && pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.db:generate: rm -rf packages/database/go/generated && cd packages/database && sqlc generate
scripts.contract:build: cd apps/contracts && forge install && forge build
scripts.gen-icons:web: rm -rf apps/web/src/components/icons && pnpm dlx @svgr/cli --typescript --icon --out-dir apps/web/src/components/icons apps/web/public/*.svg
